title: Application Intern
description:
Description

The Field Application Intern works in the sales department. In this role, it takes an engineer to help customers understand and use Intrepid products. In this position, you will work with Intrepid customers daily.

Requirements

Responsibilities

Learn Intrepid hardware and software
Attend and complete training classes offered by Intrepid (as a student).
Complete training classes on vehicle networks (face-to-face or on your own).
Learn the various applications of Intrepid products.
Assist in field & phone support, sales calls, and work with demos and manual documentation.
Help set up and teardown tradeshows, man show booth, assist customers at tradeshows, and capture lead information,
Demonstrate proficiency in sales, support, and training tasks.
Assist with training, and take the lead in customer support.
Build a project that will help you learn about vehicle networking and accomplish the needs of Intrepid (building demos).
Identify and conduct outreach to customers whose software licenses have lapsed with special renewal offers to retain customers.
note: Intrepid Control Systems: relevant no, 'Application Intern' 'works in the sales department' supporting customers on vehicle-networking hardware products, 'Assist in field & phone support, sales calls, and work with demos and manual documentation', tradeshow booth setup and 'outreach to customers whose software licenses have lapsed with special renewal offers', which is hardware applications and sales support, not software engineering. degreeOk unclear, no degree language anywhere. workAuth unclear, nothing said.
